learnings: Added `double? maxCost = null` parameter to `IDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckList` interface.
Added `maxCost` branching to `MoxfieldDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckList`: null path keeps existing concurrent Task.WhenAll logic; non-null path delegates to `ScrapeDeckListWithMaxCostAsync`.
Applied the same `maxCost` branching to `ArchidektDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckList` preserving the null-filter on results in the concurrent path.

Extracted common sequential max-cost filtering loop into `BaseDeckInfoScraper.ScrapeDeckListWithMaxCostAsync`, which iterates links sequentially, skips failed scrapes, keeps decks whose price <= maxCost, and stops when count is reached.
